title: Haas: add 4th-axis HRT160/HRT210 indexing and .mch variants

labels.name: source:agent

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P8

body:
Add 4th-axis indexed support (`A` about X) for Haas `HRT160` and `HRT210` rotary tables in `haas.cps` and machine definitions.

Public Haas specifications list `HRT160` (160 mm platter, 127.00 mm center height, 130 deg/s) and `HRT210` (210 mm platter, 152.40 mm center height, 100 deg/s), with continuous 360-degree travel and `M10`/`M11` rotary brake clamp/unclamp.
CamCraft's machine checker already handles a lone rotary axis about X (`x_rotary_problem` in `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs:157`). Currently `tiltOk()` in `assets/posts/haas.cps:111-115` refuses all tilted moves.

Implement these changes:
- Add `VF-2` (or standard VMC) `.mch` variants with `HRT160` and `HRT210` rotary `A` axes (`axis: [1, 0, 0]`, stated center geometry, `spindle`/`tool_station` limits).
- Extend `haas.cps` following `tormach.cps` (`aRotary`) for 3+1 indexed `A` moves: retract Z safely to home before indexing, emit `M11` (unclamp) before `G0 A..`, and emit `M10` (clamp) after indexing when rotary clamping is declared.
- Gate optional `G254` / `G255` (Dynamic Work Offset, a paid Haas option) via an explicit post or machine setting, never emitting `G254` by default on unequipped controls.
- Keep refusing non-X tilts (`B` or `C`) and simultaneous 4-axis contouring until TCPC or `G93` lands.

Done means: A 3+1 indexed setup on `VF-2 + HRT160`/`HRT210` passes `machine::check` and posts safe retract plus `M11`/`G0 A..`/`M10` blocks while refusing simultaneous 4-axis motion.

Part of #1961
